test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.**

The dancers swayed dainty on the stage last night.
solution:
The correct answer is: **swayed dainty.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase** "swayed dainty."** The word "**dainty**" is **an adjective **meaning delicately small and pretty. However, in this context, it's incorrectly used as **an adverb** modifying the verb "**swayed**." The **correct adverb form is "daintily."**
 
• ***The corrected sentence would be:**__ "The dancers **swayed daintily** on the stage last night."*
 
• Explanation: **Adverbs** are used **to modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs. **When describing how the **dancers swayed, "daintily"** should be used instead of **"dainty," **as it indicates the manner in which the action is performed.
